models.name: Qwen-Image
models.where_to_get: Download the Qwen-Image weights, or use a host that offers them.
models.cost: The weights are free to download. A host may charge to run them.
models.free_tier: The weights are free to download.

models.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
models.where_to_get: Gemini, then video, and select Omni 1.1 Flash.
models.cost: Uses a Google AI plan. Check the plan page for the current price.
models.free_tier: A free plan may not include this model.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models.where_to_get: Claude with web search, and select Opus 4.6.
models.cost: Uses a Claude plan. Check the plan page for the current price.
models.free_tier: A free plan may include limited search.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.where_to_get: ChatGPT Plus ($20/month), in Work or Codex, choose GPT-6.1 Sol.
models.cost: Needs Plus ($20/month) or higher. API is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output.
models.free_tier: Not on the free plan, and not in regular Chat yet. Plus includes it in Work and Codex.
